name: hud_ui_mgr_activate_hud
description: HudUiMgr::ActivateHud forwards the supplied HUD/view rectangles through OnViewportChanged to activate and lay out the HUD viewport.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the HUD manager/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x40ff50 validates the direct forwarding call to HudUiMgr::OnViewportChanged.
The native viewport activation smoke calls HudUiMgr::ActivateHud and verifies the viewport, objective, sensor, shield, layout, and text-stack side effects produced through OnViewportChanged.
